page_hero.description: DXP AI is built for the world's most security-conscious industries. From financial services to healthcare, our platform meets the most demanding regulatory and enterprise security requirements.
page_hero.name: Page Hero

item_0.heading: SOC 2 Type II
item_0.name: Features Item
item_0.text: Annually audited by an independent third party. Our SOC 2 Type II report covers Security, Availability, Confidentiality, and Processing Integrity trust service criteria — available to customers under NDA.

item_1.heading: ISO 27001 Certified
item_1.name: Features Item
item_1.text: Our Information Security Management System (ISMS) is ISO 27001:2022 certified, demonstrating a systematic approach to managing sensitive information and mitigating risk across our entire organization.

item_2.heading: GDPR Ready
item_2.name: Features Item
item_2.text: Full GDPR compliance with data subject rights management, consent tracking, data processing agreements, and privacy-by-design architecture. Regional data residency available in EU, UK, and Switzerland.

item_3.heading: HIPAA Ready
item_3.name: Features Item
item_3.text: HIPAA-aligned architecture with Business Associate Agreement (BAA) support for healthcare customers. PHI handling controls, audit trails, and minimum necessary data access controls meet HIPAA Security Rule requirements.

section_dark.heading: Defense in Depth
section_dark.name: Section Dark
section_dark.text: Multiple layers of security controls protect your data and your users at every level of the platform.

item_0.heading: Encryption Everywhere
item_0.name: Features Item
item_0.text: AES-256 encryption at rest for all stored data. TLS 1.3 in transit across all endpoints. Optional Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) for Enterprise customers who require BYOK.

item_1.heading: RBAC & SSO
item_1.name: Features Item
item_1.text: Granular role-based access control with attribute-based policies. Native SAML 2.0 and OIDC SSO integration with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and any SAML-compatible identity provider.

item_2.heading: WAF & DDoS Protection
item_2.name: Features Item
item_2.text: Global Web Application Firewall with OWASP Top 10 ruleset. Volumetric and application-layer DDoS mitigation with automatic traffic scrubbing and anycast routing via edge CDN nodes.

item_3.heading: Immutable Audit Logs
item_3.name: Features Item
item_3.text: Tamper-evident audit logs capture every user action, data access event, and configuration change. Logs are immutable, retained for 12 months by default, and exportable to your SIEM in real time.

item_4.heading: Continuous Pen Testing
item_4.name: Features Item
item_4.text: Annual third-party penetration testing by CREST-accredited firms, plus continuous automated scanning via our bug bounty program. Critical vulnerabilities are patched within 24 hours of disclosure.

item_5.heading: Regional Data Sovereignty
item_5.name: Features Item
item_5.text: Choose where your data lives. Dedicated regional deployments available in EU (Frankfurt), UK, US (East/West), Singapore, and India. Data never leaves your chosen region without explicit consent.

item_0.answer: DXP AI uses a logical multi-tenancy model with strict data isolation enforced at the database, API, and application layers. Customer data is partitioned by tenant ID with cryptographic access controls. Enterprise customers can opt for dedicated single-tenant infrastructure for complete physical isolation.
item_0.name: Accordion Item
item_0.question: How is customer data isolated between tenants?

item_1.answer: Yes. Enterprise plan customers can bring their own encryption keys managed via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, or Google Cloud KMS. Key rotation, revocation, and access policies remain fully under your control. In the event of key revocation, data access is immediately terminated.
item_1.name: Accordion Item
item_1.question: Do you support Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK/BYOK)?

item_2.answer: Critical security incidents (P0) are acknowledged within 1 hour and have a 4-hour response SLA. High-severity (P1) incidents are acknowledged within 4 hours with a 24-hour response SLA. All customers are notified of breaches affecting their data within 72 hours, meeting GDPR Article 33 requirements.
item_2.name: Accordion Item
item_2.question: What is your SLA for security incident response?

item_3.answer: Yes. DXP AI is aligned with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023. Our India region deployment supports data localisation requirements, consent management workflows, data principal rights fulfillment, and data fiduciary obligations as required by the Act.

item_3.question: Is DXP AI compliant with India's DPDP Act?
